name: snifrig
description: Ask Claude why your Windows PC is slow. snifrig reads its own measurements, explains the cause, and suggests fixes that you approve in snifrig.
long_description: snifrig watches your PC for memory leaks, runaway apps and Windows slowdowns. This extension lets Claude read what snifrig sees (status, live processes, alerts, recent fixes) and explain why the PC is slow. Claude can suggest a gentle change, such as putting a background app in efficiency mode, but it can never apply one: every suggestion waits for your OK in the snifrig window. Reading is free; suggestions need snifrig fix.

tools.name: snifrig_status
tools.description: Headline, causes, live CPU and RAM, GPU, what the governor is easing

tools.name: snifrig_why_slow
tools.description: snifrig's own explanation of why the PC is slow right now

tools.name: snifrig_report
tools.description: Slowdown, alert and leak summary for the last N days

tools.name: snifrig_top_processes
tools.description: Live per-process CPU, memory and handles

tools.name: snifrig_recent_activity
tools.description: What the fixer and governor recently did

tools.name: snifrig_rules
tools.description: Current fix rules and governor settings

tools.name: snifrig_suggest
tools.description: Propose a rule or setting for you to accept in snifrig (needs snifrig fix; never changes anything itself)
